name: saragadam-rohith/airfare-index
what_it_holds: Interactive Streamlit/Plotly app that processes airfare data and computes/visualizes a price index across routes, airlines, time periods; updated Aug 2026. Part of a large cluster of near-identical 'Smart India Hackathon 2026 SIH26056' student teams (dozens of repos named airfare-index / apix-airfare-index / mospi-airfare-index) building a real-time Indian domestic airfare CPI-style index via web scraping of OTAs, for India's MoSPI/NSO.
why_useful: If any of these SIH26056 teams committed working scraper+index code and sample output, it is a template for a India-domestic airfare price index (Jevons-index CPI methodology) that could proxy APAC/India travel-cost inflation (gap 7 APAC regional). Quality/completeness is unverified across ~25 near-duplicate student repos found; flagging the cluster rather than each repo.

name: flight-tracker (AndrewFoudree)
what_it_holds: Serverless flight-price tracker with GitHub Actions cron (weekly). Commits an append-only data/prices.csv (route, departure/return dates, party size, fare, carrier, stops, booking URL) plus data/fare_baseline.json (historical market pricing sourced from US DOT data) and data/usage.csv. Currently tracks a small route set (DSM-STT, DSM-SJU, DSM-DEN) via SerpAPI + Travelpayouts. Small, personal-scale panel, updated in-repo.
why_useful: Demonstrates a working, fully in-repo (git-committed CSV) point-in-time fare-history pattern that is directly reusable as a template for a team-run tracker; the fare_baseline.json also references DOT-derived historical pricing worth checking for reusable fields.
themes: Airline fare tracking datasets (Google Flights scrapers, Skyscanner, Hopper reports), airfare price indices
why_all: Demonstrates a working, fully in-repo (git-committed CSV) point-in-time fare-history pattern that is directly reusable as a template for a team-run tracker; the fare_baseline.json also references DOT-derived historical pricing worth checking for reusable fields.
